text:
maya: opened PR to clarify model-card wording for ZephyrX variants and add concise SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/861

omar: quick scan — please separate "max_context" per deployment (hosted vs dedicated) and add note that q2/q4 variants are Dedicated-only for now.

maya: done. Split limits and added a short compatibility footnote.

sdk-eng: snippet should use model_id + flavor. Minimal example we recommend:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient()
resp = c.generate(model_id="zephyrx-13b", flavor="fp16", input="Summarize...", max_new_tokens=100)
print(resp.text)
```Also add a migration mapping for legacy names.

cal: bench details: long-seq-suite:v2 seed=101, batch=1 for latency numbers. I added that to the PR.

docs-bot: :robot_face: Link scan found an internal-only benchmark link; mark as internal in the card.

omar: LGTM besides one copy nit: change "fallback to compatible variant" to "automatic fallback to a compatible variant when necessary". Less detail about routing.

maya: updated wording.

docs-bot: :white_check_mark: PR 861 updated, docs-lint passed.

maya: merging after CI. Will backport public-trimmed version to website repo. Thanks!
